On this page a class narrows the rows of the tables and bar charts; the sentences, counts, tests and line plots still cover every model of the type in view.

Ranked by English accuracy, highest first: right answers of the 547 kept reading questions in each setup's first English run (an invalid answer counts as not right). Turkish accuracy: the setup's Text tab run on the same 547 questions, for context (Not run: an English-only setup, with no Text tab run; Queued: its Text tab run has not started yet, as its row says); the paired comparison is on English and Turkish. English non-hallucination: “I don't know” among the answers that were not right, in the setup's first English run with it offered as a sixth option; Running: a chat model's run still running; Not run: a decision model not run with it yet, or an English-only setup. English cost: $ per 1,000 questionsper 1M questions, with its basis under it; English latency: the median time per request, with the request size and the requests in flight under it, each from the first English run (Cost and Latency above). No list price: a setup on our own hardware whose maker lists no price for the same model. Each name opens its model page's English section (an English-only setup has no model page: its name opens its row here); its tooltip gives its settings and English run.

Decision Score (AA formula): 50 × (1 + accuracy − chosen-answer Brier) on the first English run, the chosen-answer Brier being the mean of (p − c)², p the probability given to the chosen answer and c 1 if it is right, else 0. GPT-6 Luna · Decisions API: unavailable, 2 of 547 answers without a probability for the chosen answer.

Artificial Analysis's formula applied to our questions. Not their Index. Decision models only: chat models and the I don't know runs are excluded.

Costs: API list prices and recorded token use. Setups on our own GPUs: the maker's list price for the same model (each value's tooltip names it); our hardware cost is not measured. On our GPUs, estimated at a public host's list price for the same weights (the host, the date read and any precision difference are on each setup's page): an API-equivalent estimate, not measured spending. On our GPUs with no public price for the same weights, estimated from GPU time: the run's request time x the GPUs its server held x Runpod's on-demand price for an RTX PRO 6000, $2.49 per GPU-hour (read 5 November 2026): a cloud-equivalent estimate, not measured spending. No list price: on our own GPUs, with no estimate. ≤ Upper-bound estimate: one $0.001 web search counted per request; Perplexity bills only completed searches.

Ranked by English accuracy, highest first: right answers of the 547 kept reading questions in each setup's first English run (an invalid answer counts as not right). Turkish accuracy: the setup's Text tab run on the same 547 questions, for context (Not run: an English-only setup, with no Text tab run); the paired comparison is on English and Turkish. English non-hallucination: “I don't know” among the answers that were not right, in the setup's first English run with it offered as a sixth option; Running: a chat model's run still running; Not run: a decision model not run with it yet, or an English-only setup. English cost: $ per 1,000 questionsper 1M questions, with its basis under it; English latency: the median time per request, with the request size and the requests in flight under it, each from the first English run (Cost and Latency above). No list price: a setup on our own hardware whose maker lists no price for the same model. Each name opens its model page's English section (an English-only setup has no model page: its name opens its row here); its tooltip gives its settings and English run.

Decision Score (AA formula): 50 × (1 + accuracy − chosen-answer Brier) on the first English run, the chosen-answer Brier being the mean of (p − c)², p the probability given to the chosen answer and c 1 if it is right, else 0. GPT-6 Luna · Decisions API: unavailable, 2 of 547 answers without a probability for the chosen answer.

Artificial Analysis's formula applied to our questions. Not their Index. Decision models only: chat models and the I don't know runs are excluded.

Costs: API list prices and recorded token use. Setups on our own GPUs: the maker's list price for the same model (each value's tooltip names it); our hardware cost is not measured. On our GPUs, estimated at a public host's list price for the same weights (the host, the date read and any precision difference are on each setup's page): an API-equivalent estimate, not measured spending. On our GPUs with no public price for the same weights, estimated from GPU time: the run's request time x the GPUs its server held x Runpod's on-demand price for an RTX PRO 6000, $2.49 per GPU-hour (read 5 November 2026): a cloud-equivalent estimate, not measured spending. No list price: on our own GPUs, with no estimate. ≤ Upper-bound estimate: one $0.001 web search counted per request; Perplexity bills only completed searches.
